desc:
[Halloween Update] This fall brings cold winds, and with them blows in a mysterious, pointy-eared visitor to the town…

Catch the oddly familiar new threat in the sea, rescue the CatSeals, and save Halloween!
+ Enjoy the many improvements to Hunting, including the Heat System to boost the chance of rare and dangerous fish
+ Gather 4+ new CatSeals in Quests and the Seal Shop!
+ Ragdoll + Orange CatSeal Pack available
+ New exclusive questline U.F.S. Spotting is available for owners of Glorpy!
+ Trick or Treat is back!
+ New Calendar with exclusive Rewards
+ Overhaul of the asset system: Less Memory use, and faster loads


Fish, Swim, Explore, Play, and Be a Silly Seal in this seally game!

Fish and Explore the sea for treasures to earn Sealcoins
Customize your seal, your way with different styles, shapes, hats, and gears

Like the game and Join the Group for 100 free Sealcoins

x2 Daily Reward Sealcoins for Premium Subscribers

If any seal has lost data please create a ticket!
